meta.name: type-check-baselines
meta.description: Run, refresh, or recover from RedisInsight's per-project TypeScript error baselines (.tscheck.rec.json). Use when CI reports "baseline is outdated" or "more TS errors than previously recorded", when the user mentions tscheck / type-check / .tscheck.rec.json, when introducing or fixing TS errors, or when reviewing PRs that touch baseline files.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 TypeScript 错误基线文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 CI 中维护 TypeScript 错误基线
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to maintain TypeScript error baselines in CI

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以运行 TypeScript 错误检查、刷新错误基线文件（.tscheck.rec.json），或恢复因 CI 报告“基线过期”或“错误数增加”而触发的问题。
howto.when: 当 CI 报告“基线过期”或“错误数增加”、用户提到 tscheck/type-check/.tscheck.rec.json、引入或修复 TS 错误、或审查涉及基线文件的 PR 时触发。

say.text: 运行 type-check 检查当前项目。
刷新 TS 错误基线。
处理 CI 报告的基线过期问题。
say.note: Claude 会指导你刷新基线并提交更新。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run TypeScript error checks, refresh error baseline files (.tscheck.rec.json), or recover from issues triggered by CI reports of "baseline outdated" or "more TS errors than previously recorded."
howto.when_en: Triggered when CI reports "baseline outdated" or "more TS errors than previously recorded," when the user mentions tscheck/type-check/.tscheck.rec.json, when introducing or fixing TS errors, or when reviewing PRs that touch baseline files.

say_en.text: Run type-check on the current project.
say_en.note: Claude executes npm run type-check and reports results.
After fixing errors, update baseline files via npm run tscheck.

say_en.text: Handle the CI baseline outdated report.
say_en.note: Claude guides you to refresh baselines and commit updates.
